name: Gorpcore

influenced_by: a joke term ("gorp," trail mix) applied to high-fashion runway adoption of hiking brands

places: high fashion runways adopting brands like Arc'teryx and Salomon
reacts_against: fashion's historical disdain for purely functional outdoor gear, elevating it to high-fashion status instead.

wiki_facts.key_motifs: Utilitarianism, layering, technical fabrics, earthy and muted color palettes, comfort, durability, logos of outdoor brands
wiki_facts.key_colours: Earthy tones (brown, green, grey, khaki), black, white, with occasional bright pops (orange, yellow, blue, red)
wiki_facts.key_values: Functionality, practicality, comfort, durability, preparedness, appreciation for nature (aestheticized)

findings: mostly muted — about 74% of the measured color is low-saturation (greys, dusty tones)
measured.caveat: Colors measured from the Aesthetics Wiki images as photographed and displayed on screen; actual materials vary, and screen colors are approximate.
